thread:
Claire: fyi toggled tenant:aurora to prefer v2, but billing dashboard still shows almost all usage under v1. Support is getting tickets.
Omar: do we currently attribute quota to requested or executed variant?
Ted: executed today. so fallbacks make customer-facing usage for v2 look low.
Claire: we need to decide: customers expect their quota meter to reflect what they asked for. Proposal: quota attribution = requested_variant, infra cost attribution = executed_variant.
Ux: that'll need clear console copy. Suggest: small line under route badge: 'Quota billed to: <requested> · Executed on: <effective> (reason)'. Tooltip explains the split.
Ted: telemetry changes required: add fields `x-rw-requested-variant`, `x-rw-executed-variant`, `fallback_reason` (enum). Also add `fallback_sample` boolean and `sequence_length_hint` when reason==seqlen-exceeded.
Omar: also add a metric: `route_fallbacks_total{tenant,requested,executed,reason}` and a PromQL example for alerts: `sum by(tenant)(increase(route_fallbacks_total[24h])) / sum by(tenant)(increase(route_requests_total[24h])) > 0.02` -> alert on >2% fallback-rate.
Claire: nice. For rollout UX we should add an amber 'config != effective' badge when they differ for >10s. UX: amber badge + hover text 'effective variant may be pinned; see traces'.
Ux: I will mock the badge and the copy. Also propose a lightweight 'migration-mode' toggle: when enabled, we bill quota to requested but show both meters and allow a 7-day run where infra cost differences are surfaced to finance. This helps customers test v2 without worrying about quota.
Finance-bot: FYI finance wants a nightly reconcile CSV: requested_quota_usage vs infra_cost_by_executed_variant. If variance >10% for a tenant, page the cloud-cost channel.
Ted: implement reconcile job: aggregate daily and emit cost-delta metric. Also enable 0.5% trace sampling for fallbacks to help SRE diagnose kv-cache/pinning issues.
Omar: we should codify precedence in the spec: token header -> tenant override -> route default -> global default. I'll add that to the doc.
Claire: action items: Ted (telemetry + reconcile job + sampling), Omar (spec + precedence table), Ux (badge + copy + migration-mode mock), Finance-bot (reconcile alert hook). I'll open the PRs and link them.
Finance-bot: ack. Will coordinate on reconcile CSV schema.
Claire: thanks all. Let's roll a 1% fallback sample for top 5 tenants first and expand.
Ted: enabling sample now on staging group 'migration-experiments'.
Ux: will ping when mocks are ready.
Claire: good. Closing loop once staging shows both requested & executed in console.
